_approach: RYM's genre page lists Cumbia and Funk mandelão among krushclub's fusion partners, alongside RYM's note that krushclub sometimes runs a 'four-on-the-floor rhythm' instead of the Jersey shape. This groove takes that branch: straight four-on-the-floor kick, a guacharaca-style clave 16th ostinato (the cumbia signature), and a tamborzão-style syncopated congaHigh/congaLow call-and-response standing in for funk mandelão's rolling low tom pattern, with the clap kept on 2 and 4 to stay legible as club music.
